title: Continuous L Dining Banquette
description: One original static inward-facing L-shaped dining banquette with unequal seating runs, one continuous concave L cushion, one uninterrupted turning L back, a whole wooden L foundation and a recessed dark L plinth. Both seating directions and the inside corner are newly authored complete closed profiles rather than duplicated, rotated or merged old sofa/booth components. Four separately editable closed meshes and four constant opaque matte PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal full-bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes; no table, wall, furnishings or snap-system parts. Original interior depth expansion for a corner seat, distinct from the existing straight booth, armrest sofa and open ring bench. Static visual furniture only: no animation, upholstery simulation, ergonomic fit, load, stability, installation, accessibility, fire safety or compatibility certification.
